title: Empirical evidence of the effectiveness of concept mapping as a learning intervention for nuclear medicine technology students in a distance learning radiation protection and biology course
reason: Historical-cohort comparison of final examination scores between distance students who did concept mapping and a control cohort. Concept maps are not scored or related to outcomes; only a group achievement contrast is reported.

extraction.n_quote: in the study was 25. The learning intervention (concept ... mapping) group consisted of 19 students.
extraction.population: baccalaureate nuclear medicine technology students, online distance section, 1 university
extraction.lms_indicators: none (concept maps used for remediation, not measured)
extraction.notes: Reported 'effect size' 2.65 is a group difference in mean exam scores (treatment vs control), not an indicator-outcome relation.
